# AMD AMF headers

Only the public C++ headers are vendored; the AMD display driver supplies `amfrt64.dll`.

Source: https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/AMF
Commit: `57ee0cfb0e1a08d9041f77435653794c1b012be0` (AMF 1.5.3).
License: [MIT and standards notice](LICENSE.txt).
